messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cardinalhealth.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + sequencing questions for pilot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and legal leads asked me to get a clear mutual action plan (MAP) for the pilot so they can map internal approvals. Two quick asks to start:

1) Sequence: does Cardinal need the MSA signed before DPA/order form review begins, or can legal iterate on the DPA while procurement and engineering run the evaluation?
2) Acceptance windows: what are the minimal acceptance gates you expect for the pilot (data retention, performance SLAs, sample evaluation sets)?
3) Attachments: I attached an internal template to show what procurement expects.

If you can send a draft MAP and a target timeline this week we can tee up legal and procurement reviewers.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Morgan
Sr. Sourcing Manager — Cardinal Health
Attachment: Cardinal_MAP_req_0908.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + sequencing questions for pilot

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (legal) and Marissa (CS/AM) to align on sequencing. Quick reply with a working plan attached: Redwood_MAP_v0.2.xlsx plus our SOC2 summary for evidence. High-level proposal below — happy to jump on a 30m call if you prefer.

Proposed sequencing (shortened):
- Week 0: Mutual action plan sign-off (MAP acknowledges parallel review).
- Weeks 1–2: Legal runs DPA review in parallel with Redwood providing evidence (SOC2 summary attached).
- Weeks 2–3: Procurement and legal iterate order form (pricing, billing net terms).
- Week 3: Conditional kickoff (engineering sandbox + limited API keys) once DPA rubric is agreed; final MSA signature prioritized before production traffic.

Acceptance windows & gating (minimums):
- Functional eval: 10 business days with provided prompt/test set (pass rate >= 92% on agreed metrics).
- Performance: median p95 latency <= 450ms for 50-token test profile.
- Data handling: KV/caching options documented; retention settings agreed and logged in the MAP.

Open questions for Cardinal:
- Do you require the fully executed DPA before any sandbox access, or is a signed letter of intent + agreed redlines sufficient for a conditional kickoff?
- Procurement: confirm billing cadence (net30/net45) and any PO process we need to follow.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v0.2.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0172

Alex / Hannah — quick legal note after reviewing the MAP draft and Cardinal template. We want to avoid blocking the pilot unnecessarily while still meeting Cardinal's compliance needs. Suggested approach:

1) Parallel review with a gating control: Redwood will provide a signed DPA redlines document and SOC2 evidence within 3 business days of MAP sign-off.
2) Conditional sandbox: allow synthetic-data sandbox access immediately after MAP sign-off; production data ingestion gated on DPA signature.
3) Order form: negotiate commercial terms (pricing & PO cadence) in parallel; include an explicit clause that final MSA signature is required within 30 days of pilot acceptance to continue production services.

Attachment: redwood-dpa-markup-0913.pdf (pdf)

If Cardinal insists on the DPA executed before any activity, we will comply — just want to document time-to-execute implications for the pilot timeline. Happy to join a legal call if you want to walk through redlines.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations — Redwood Inference

- DPA: Redwood to send DPA redlines by EOD 9/17; Cardinal legal to comment within 3 business days. No customer data ingestion until both parties agree to DPA rubric.

- Conditional kickoff: sandbox access for integration and functional eval begins 9/20. Production cutover contingent on DPA execution and MSA signature within the 30-day post-acceptance window.
- Acceptance criteria: see attached MAP (Redwood_MAP_v0.2.xlsx) — pass/fail thresholds + test set defined.

Action owners & immediate tasks:
- Redwood (Hannah / Marissa): send order form draft and DocuSign envelope for DPA redline acknowledgment by 9/17.
- Redwood (Karthik): finalize DPA redline packet and join legal sync if Cardinal requires.
- Cardinal (Alex / Lena / procurement): confirm PO flow and internal reviewer list by 9/18.
